title: Completed-coefficient finite free cells and canonical reduction maps
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, with valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $T$ be any scheme [def-pc-scheme] and work on its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For $n\in\mathbf N$ put $C_n=(R/\varpi^{n+1})_T$ and $B_T=\varprojlim_n C_n$, with its actual coordinate projections $\pi_n:B_T\to C_n$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Write $\operatorname{Mod}(B_T)$ and $\operatorname{Mod}(C_n)$ for module-sheaf categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and use their unbounded derived categories with localization $Q$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Use the canonical scalar restriction $\operatorname{Res}_n$ along $\pi_n$, together with its termwise derived restriction [def-sf-scalar-reduction-categories-restriction], and the derived scalar extension $L_n=-\otimes^L_{B_T}C_n$ [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction]. Define the residue module to be $\operatorname{Res}_n(C_n)$, with $C_n$ its unit module. Define the quotient projection $q_n:B_T\to\operatorname{Res}_n(C_n)$ as the $B_T$-linear sheaf map sending $1$ to $1$, equivalently the coefficient projection $\pi_n$ on sections. For every $r\in\mathbf N$ (including $r=0$) and $d\in\mathbf Z$, define the finite free cell $F_{r,d}$ as the single cochain complex in degree $d$ on $\prod_{i\in\operatorname{Fin}(r)}B_T$; this finite product is the canonical finite direct sum. For $M\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(B_T))$, define $\eta_n(M):M\to\operatorname{Res}_n(L_n M)$ to be the unit at $M$ of the normalized derived extension-restriction adjunction [lem-weil-derived-scalar-extension-restriction-adjunction], using its prescribed comparison with the ordinary unit $x\mapsto1\otimes x$ on K-flat representatives. No boundedness, quasi-compactness or nonempty-scheme condition is imposed, and the scheme and coefficient universes are independent.
